# Plotraa

> Plotraa is WhatsApp-first real estate software for property dealers in India. A dealer sends property details as a normal WhatsApp message and Plotraa turns it into a shareable listing page with photos and a map location, then keeps every buyer enquiry in one dashboard. Launched in Ludhiana, Punjab. Built by Wayne E Solutions.

Plotraa (two a's) is not related to "Plotra", a comics app.

## Key facts

- Who it is for: property dealers, real estate agents and dealer teams in Punjab and Chandigarh (Ludhiana, Mohali, Kharar, Jalandhar, Patiala, Amritsar)
- How it works: send plot size, location, price (optional) and photos on WhatsApp; get a listing link to share with buyers
- Team plans: dashboard with per-agent listing attribution
- Pricing: monthly plans, no lock-in. Current prices: https://plotraa.com/pricing
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 93951 90000, info@plotraa.com
